Eloise Park: Marco handed in his notice today. Tentative last active day is 1860067200 (Fri). Can we run through the offboard checklist and timing?
Marco Alvarez: Confirmed. Im aiming for the end of week handoff. Need to know COBRA timing, PTO payout, asset return, and when my Slack/Okta will be disabled.
Eloise Park: High-level plan: benefits packet + COBRA window, payroll confirm final paycheck & PTO payout, IT to send prepaid label and deprovision schedule, manager to schedule exit interview + KT.
Benefits: COBRA election window = 60 days from separation. We email the packet within ~7 business days after HR processes separation. Coverage typically ends last day of month unless employee elects end-of-day separation processing.
Marco Alvarez: State question: I'm in CA  will unused vacation be paid out?
Benefits: CA law usually requires payout of accrued PTO on separation; payroll will confirm the payout amount and inclusion date (usually final paycheck). We'll follow up by EOD tomorrow.
IT-Support: We will generate a prepaid shipping label for the laptop and include packing instructions. Deprovision plan: revoke SSO + console roles at 06:00 UTC the morning after your last active day. Email forwarding will be set for 30 days by default.
Marco Alvarez: I have a personal AWS key in a local build script and two service accounts that I maintain. I will remove the personal key today. For the service accounts, can we transfer ownership first?
IT-Support: For service account handoffs, open a ticket with tag `soa-transfer`. We will hold key rotation until ownership is transferred. Please add a transfer doc listing repos and contacts.
Eloise Park: Marco, please drop a short transfer doc in:
```
/team-handovers/marco-offboard
```
and mention any active PRs, cron jobs, and runbooks.
Marco Alvarez: Done. Uploaded the doc with links to repos and a list of cron jobs.
offboard-bot: Automated offboard checklist created: tasks assigned to Eloise (manager sign-off), IT-Support (label + deprovision), Benefits (COBRA packet + PTO confirmation), Marco (handoff doc + creds cleanup). Exit interview scheduled tentatively.
Eloise Park: Marco, what day/time next week works for a 60-min KT session?
Marco Alvarez: Wednesday 09:30 PT (1860027000) works for me.
IT-Support: Shipping label ETA: 24-48 hours. Please include signed asset form or a scanned copy in the package. We'll perform an audit when device arrives. Wiping: we ask employees to remove personal files; we will run an audited factory reset on receipt.
Marco Alvarez: Thanks. Also, will MFA on my phone be unenrolled automatically? I need it for a few last tasks.
IT-Support: MFA will remain until SSO is revoked at deprovision time. If you need short-term exceptions, flag them in the `soa-transfer` ticket.
Benefits: Payroll note: final paycheck timing depends on payroll cutoffs. We'll confirm whether PTO payout is on the final paycheck or separate remittance. Expect confirmation by EOD.
Eloise Park: Recap: Benefits confirm PTO payout + send COBRA packet; IT-Support send label + perform key sweep after transfer; Marco remove personal creds and complete transfer doc; offboard-bot to send exit survey after last day. I'll set the KT and exit interview invites.
Marco Alvarez: I appreciate the coordination. I'll ping here once personal key is removed and transfer doc finalized. :raised_hands:
Eloise Park: Closing loop once payroll confirms final pay. If anything else needed, add to this thread. :eyes:
